evidence.quote: The γ′ precipitates coarsening rate of four HEAs were determined to be 1.91 × 10 29, 2.42 × 10 29, 2.38 × 10 29, 2.52 × 10 29 m3/s, respectively. All of which are superior compared to previous Ni-based superalloys and HEAs.

By adding Mo and V elements, the lattice misfit values of alloys were effectively reduced from 0.33025% (Mo0V0 HEA) to 0.06483% (Mo2.5V0 HEA), 0.24711% (Mo0V2.5 HEA) and 0.05542% (Mo2.5V2.5 HEA), Mo2.5V2.5 HEA owns the smallest lattice misfit value.
